services.title: Grooming services
services.intro: Each groom is fitted to your dog's breed and coat, and to the cut you ask for. Prices depend on size and coat condition.

fullGroom.text: Bath, blow-dry, brush out, cut and style, nails and ears.

puppy.title: Puppy sessions
puppy.text: A block of 3 short, calm sessions that get puppies used to the table, the dryer and the clippers.

bathTidy.title: Bath & tidy
bathTidy.text: For between full grooms: bath, dry, brush, and a tidy of the face, feet and bottom.

who.title: Who I am
who.text: This website belongs to Pampered Pooch, a dog grooming business run by Sophie at 17 Victoria Avenue, Porthcawl. I am the person who decides how your details are used.

form.title: The enquiry form
form.text: If you use the form I collect your name, email address, phone number if you add one, your dog's name and breed, the service you pick and your message. The form is sent to me as an email using a service called EmailJS. I use your details to reply to your enquiry and to arrange your appointment. I do not use them for anything else and I do not sell them.
form.keep: I keep enquiry emails for as long as I need them to deal with your booking and for my business records. You can ask me to delete them at any time.

cookies.title: Cookies and Google Analytics
cookies.textOff: This website does not currently use any cookies or analytics, and the cookie banner does not appear.
cookies.textOn: I would like to use Google Analytics to count visits and see which pages are read. It only loads if you press Accept on the cookie banner, and nothing is set before then. If you press Decline, no analytics are used. Your choice is remembered in your browser. Google Analytics is provided by Google, who process the data it collects.
cookies.storage: The only thing this website stores in your browser is your cookie choice.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask to see the details I hold about you, to correct them or to have them deleted. If you are unhappy with how I have handled your details you can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.
